questions.text: In HTML, which of the following can be considered a container?
questions.solution:
A container tag holds other content between its opening and closing tags. BODY contains the whole visible page (as per the key).

Answer: d (BODY)

questions.text: The IEEE standard for WiMax technology is
questions.solution:
WiMAX (broadband wireless access) is standardised as IEEE 802.16. (802.11 is Wi-Fi.)

Answer: IEEE 802.16
